headline: 2 women killed in collision between auto-rickshaw and human hauler in Jamalpur
summary: The accident occurred on the Jamalpur-Dewanganj regional road, leaving three others injured.
details: Two women were killed and three others injured in a head-on collision between a CNG-run auto-rickshaw and a human hauler, known as a 'bhotbhoti', in Jamalpur's Melandah upazila.

caption:
A head-on collision in Jamalpur has left two women dead and three others injured.

Two women were killed and three others injured in a head-on collision between a CNG-run auto-rickshaw and a human hauler, known as a 'bhotbhoti', in Jamalpur's Melandah upazila.

The accident took place around 3:00 pm on the Jamalpur-Dewanganj regional road in the Betmari area under Charbani Pakuria union.

One woman died on the spot, while another succumbed to her injuries later at the hospital.

The injured were identified as Mojibor (55), Jibon Mia (35), and Tushar (38), all residents of the Katharbil area in Dewanganj upazila.

Dr. Uzzwal Kumar Sarkar of Jamalpur General Hospital confirmed that five people were brought to the hospital, two of whom died.

Melandah Police Station Officer-in-Charge ATM Mahmudul Haque stated that police have been dispatched to the hospital following the report of the accident.

headline_marked: 4 children die as [[measles death toll rises to 788]] in Bangladesh
headline: 4 children die as measles death toll rises to 788 in Bangladesh
summary: Four more children died within 24 hours with measles-like symptoms, according to the DGHS.
details: Four children died with measles-like symptoms in a 24-hour period ending at 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
This brings the combined total of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths in the country to 788.
Of these fatalities, 693 are suspected measles deaths, while 95 have been laboratory-confirmed.
In the last 24 hours, 938 new suspected cases were reported, bringing the national cumulative total of suspected cases to 117,648.
Additionally, 113 new confirmed cases were recorded, raising the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 14,431.
Since March 15, a total of 100,137 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalised across the country, with 96,521 of them having recovered.
caption:
4 children dead in 24 hours. The measles death toll in Bangladesh has reached 788.

Four children died with measles-like symptoms in a 24-hour period ending at 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

This brings the combined total of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths in the country to 788.

Of these fatalities, 693 are suspected measles deaths, while 95 have been laboratory-confirmed.

In the last 24 hours, 938 new suspected cases were reported, bringing the national cumulative total of suspected cases to 117,648.

Additionally, 113 new confirmed cases were recorded, raising the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 14,431.

Since March 15, a total of 100,137 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalised across the country, with 96,521 of them having recovered.
